price.quote: With builds starting at $2499 for the Altus build spec and going up to $3499 for GRX, it’s clear Salsa is marketing the Confluence towards the entry level eGravel market.

cls.basis: maker states Class 1; spec lists Throttle No

cls.quote: Salsa Cycles just announced its entrance into the world of eBikes with the first model in the brand’s “light electric” lineup being the Confluence gravel bike, a Class I flat or drop bar gravel bike with 250-watt hour powered by a Mahle x35+ system. Let’s check out this new lineup below…
cls.basis: launch article covering the whole Confluence line

spd.quote: With an aluminum chassis, these bikes utilize the lightweight Mahle x35+ motor and feature a 250 watt hour batter for a top assisted speed of 20mph/32kph vis a vis a 40nm assist.

tq.quote: With an aluminum chassis, these bikes utilize the lightweight Mahle x35+ motor and feature a 250 watt hour batter for a top assisted speed of 20mph/32kph vis a vis a 40nm assist.

The Confluence features an aluminum frame and carbon fiber fork and uses a Mahle 250W, 40Nm hub motor. A 250Wh internal battery powers the hub, which Salsa estimates can offer riders up to 45 mi. of range per charge. The Confluence comes in four different builds—two with a flat bar and two with a drop bar—ranging from $2499 up to $3499.
tq.basis: 2024 launch news article covering the whole X35+ Confluence line
